animals: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance!

science: Honey never spoils! Archaeologists found 3000-year-old honey still good to eat!

history: The Great Wall of China took over 2000 years to build!

body: Your body has enough iron in it to make a nail 3 inches long!

Your fingernails grow faster on your dominant hand!
